text:
maria-support: Customer Acme (acct: acme-prod) reporting rerank results that don't match the candidate order they send. They call TS SDK v2.4.1 and say returned scores look paired to different items. Repro steps below — /cc @mike-eng

mike-eng: Can you paste the exact request payload we forwarded to the rerank endpoint? raw gateway logs would help.

maria-support: Minimal repro from customer (TypeScript):
```ts
const candidates = [{id:1, text:'A'},{id:10, text:'B'},{id:2, text:'C'}];
await client.rerank({query: 'some query', candidates});
```
They expect ordering [1,10,2] but server shows candidates arrived as [1,2,10]. Customer attached our request log with body that looks like an object with numeric-string keys: `{"0":{...},"1":{...},"2":{...}}` rather than a proper array.

leo-dev: Huh. If a Map or keyed object is passed through serialization code that does `Object.keys()` and then `.sort()` you can end up with lexicographic ordering of numeric ids ("10" < "2"). Which ts-sdk function is serializing candidates?

sam-devex: I reproduced quickly — RerankClient.toPayload in v2.4.1 does a defensive transform: `const keys = Object.keys(candidates);` then later `keys.sort()` in some code path when candidates aren't a true Array. If the caller passed a Map or an object with numeric keys, keys are strings and sort is lexicographic. That reorders them before we build the array.

mike-eng: I can reproduce locally with the snippet. When candidates is a Map we end up with `{"0":...,"1":...,"10":...}` vs array `[..., ..., ...]`. Patch plan: treat any non-Array as an iterable and call `Array.from(...)`; avoid calling `.sort()` on keys. Also add unit test with numeric ids and map input.

leo-dev: Agreed. Server-side mitigation too: pair returned scores to candidate ids instead of relying on index position when possible. That will make results robust to client-side reordering.

maria-support: :+1: Please advise customer — can they pin to v2.4.0 as workaround or convert their Map to an Array before calling? ETA on SDK patch?

mike-eng: Cutting hotfix now. Bumping to v2.4.2 with the Array.from(map.values()) change and added tests. Publishing to npm and rolling canary. ETA ~20m. Ticket RANK-452 created for followups.

rerank-bot: deploy started for ts-sdk v2.4.2 — canary 5%

maria-support: I'll update the customer and include the workaround (array conversion) and mention patch will be available shortly. Thanks!
